hero.title: File:Martin and Moehonua, injured survivors of Honolulu Courthouse Riot of 1874.jpg
hero.credit: Bernice Pauahi Bishop MuseumJon Kamakawiwoʻole Osorio (2002)       Dismembering Lāhui: a history of the Hawaiian nation to 1887, University of Hawaii Press, p. 156
hero.source: Martin and Moehonua, injured survivors of Honolulu Courthouse Riot of 1874
hero.description: Representatives William Thomas Martin and William Luther Moehonua, survivors of the attack on the legislative assembly by Queen Emma's supporters, 12 February 1874. Kalakaua made Moehonua his first minister of the interior and later governor of O'ahu. Martin did not return to the legislature.
